cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton, and at 14:00 GMT on Thursday, the 10th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿。现在是9月10日星期四格林尼治时间14点，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: A massive search operation is continuing in the waters off the Philippines following an explosion on board a ferry. Dozens of people are missing.
cues.zh: 菲律宾近海一艘渡轮发生爆炸后，大规模搜救行动仍在继续。数十人失踪。

cues.en: A port city in Yemen has just been captured by the Houthi rebel group, a major blow to the Yemeni government which has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade.
cues.zh: 也门一座港口城市刚被胡塞叛军夺取，这是对与胡塞武装交战十多年的也门政府的重大打击。

cues.en: We'll hear from the region.
cues.zh: 我们将听取来自该地区的报道。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, you might remember the excitement around the Artemis Moon Mission in April.
cues.zh: 本期还将报道：你或许还记得4月阿耳忒弥斯登月任务引发的轰动。

cues.en: I have absolutely no idea what to say.
cues.zh: 我完全不知道该说什么。

cues.en: This is... 24 hours ago, the Earth was that big out the window and we were doing Mach 39, and here we are back at Ellington at home.
cues.zh: 这真是……24小时前，窗外的地球还那么大，而我们正以39马赫飞行；现在我们已经回到埃灵顿的家中。

cues.en: Two of the astronauts involved with that say they won't be involved in spaceflight again.
cues.zh: 参与该任务的四名宇航员中，有两人表示不会再参与太空飞行。

cues.en: We'll tell you more.
cues.zh: 稍后为你详细介绍。

cues.en: Now to the Philippines. It's nighttime there as we record this podcast, and rescuers are frantically searching for around 90 people missing.
cues.zh: 现在来看菲律宾的消息。我们录制本期播客时，当地正值夜间，救援人员正在拼命搜寻约90名失踪人员。

cues.en: A passenger ferry caught fire after an explosion.
cues.zh: 一艘客轮在爆炸后起火。

cues.en: Five have already been found dead.
cues.zh: 已有5人被发现死亡。

cues.en: The ferry, the MV June Aster, is afloat but tilting heavily to one side.
cues.zh: 这艘名为 MV June Aster 的渡轮仍漂浮在水面上，但严重向一侧倾斜。

cues.en: The Philippine Coast Guard has held a news conference. Its spokesperson, Commodore Noemie Cayabyab, said thick smoke continues to billow from the vessel.
cues.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队举行了新闻发布会。其发言人诺埃米·卡亚比亚布准将说，船只仍不断冒出浓烟。

cues.en: That's preventing rescuers from boarding the ship.
cues.zh: 浓烟阻碍救援人员登船。

cues.en: The challenge we're seeing right now is the strong winds. So that is limiting our response.
cues.zh: 我们眼下遇到的挑战是强风，这限制了我们的应对行动。

cues.en: No matter how much we put out the fire, there are external factors that could reignite fire.
cues.zh: 无论我们扑灭多少火，外部因素都可能让火势复燃。

cues.en: According to our Coast Guard station commander in the area, there are no longer flames inside the ship.
cues.zh: 据当地海岸警卫队站长说，船内已经没有火焰。

cues.en: What we are taking into consideration is smoke in the ship.
cues.zh: 我们需要考虑的是船内的烟雾。

cues.en: If our personnel get on board, they could be suffocated.
cues.zh: 如果我们的人员登船，可能会窒息。

cues.en: So we are ensuring the safety on the ship before we go on board.
cues.zh: 因此，在登船前，我们要先确保船上安全。

cues.en: The Philippines is an archipelago of thousands of islands, so it's dependent on boat travel.
cues.zh: 菲律宾是由数千座岛屿组成的群岛国家，因此依赖船运。

cues.en: Ferries are a cheap way to move people and cargo between islands, some of which are inaccessible by air.
cues.zh: 渡轮是岛屿之间运送人员和货物的廉价方式，其中一些岛屿无法通过航空抵达。

cues.en: But as we'll hear, it also has a very bad record for deadly marine accidents.
cues.zh: 但正如我们将听到的，菲律宾致命海上事故频发，记录相当糟糕。

cues.en: Karen Lema is the Reuters bureau chief in Manila.
cues.zh: Karen Lema 是路透社驻马尼拉分社社长。

cues.en: When I spoke with her, she began by telling me more about the news conference.
cues.zh: 我与她交谈时，她先进一步介绍了那场新闻发布会。

cues.en: The Philippine Coast Guard just ended a press conference a while ago where we heard from the spokesperson.
cues.zh: 菲律宾海岸警卫队刚刚结束新闻发布会，我们听取了发言人的介绍。

cues.en: It was about their conversation with one of the survivors, who reported hearing an explosion before the blaze quickly spread in the ferry.
cues.zh: 内容涉及他们与一名幸存者的谈话；这名幸存者说，他听到爆炸声，随后火焰迅速在渡轮上蔓延。

cues.en: That is the thing. It still remains unclear what caused it.
cues.zh: 问题就在这里：目前仍不清楚是什么引发了爆炸。

cues.en: She didn't want to speculate, obviously, on what might have been the reason behind the explosion.
cues.zh: 显然，她不愿猜测爆炸背后的原因。

cues.en: That is still a question that remains to be answered by the Philippine Coast Guard.
cues.zh: 这仍是菲律宾海岸警卫队有待回答的问题。

cues.en: And what more can you tell us about the rescue effort? Have emergency crews made it on board the ship yet?
cues.zh: 关于救援行动，你还能告诉我们什么？应急人员已经登船了吗？

cues.en: Interestingly, they have definitely deployed a lot of vessels. It's become a comprehensive rescue and search.
cues.zh: 有意思的是，他们确实部署了大量船只，已经展开全面的搜救行动。

cues.en: The problem is they could not approach the vessel at this point until the fire has been completely extinguished.
cues.zh: 问题是，在火势完全扑灭前，他们目前还无法靠近船只。

cues.en: I don't know if you've seen some of the drone footage that the Coast Guard has handed out.
cues.zh: 不知道你是否看过海岸警卫队发布的一些无人机画面。

cues.en: But you can see from these images how charred the vessel is.
cues.zh: 但从这些画面可以看到，船只被烧得面目全非。

cues.en: And there's still thick smoke that continues to billow from the vessel.
cues.zh: 船只仍在不断冒出浓烟。

cues.en: That's making it difficult for the rescuers to attempt to enter the vessel, complicating and hampering the rescue efforts.
cues.zh: 这让救援人员难以尝试进入船内，使救援工作复杂化并受到阻碍。

cues.en: They're worried about the extreme heat that rescuers might experience, and they're also concerned that there might be explosions inside the vessel.
cues.zh: 他们担心救援人员会遭遇极端高温，也担心船内可能发生爆炸。

cues.en: So we're still waiting on that.
cues.zh: 所以我们仍在等待消息。

cues.en: According to the Coast Guard, they're hoping that they could do that before the end of the day.
cues.zh: 海岸警卫队表示，他们希望能在当天结束前做到这一点。

cues.en: But yeah, it's been complicated by that.
cues.zh: 不过，是的，这让事情变得复杂。

cues.en: Karen, why are marine accidents a recurring problem in the Philippines, a country that is so dependent on boat travel?
cues.zh: Karen，菲律宾如此依赖船运，为什么海上事故却一再发生？

cues.en: A ferry capsized in January, killing at least 65 people.
cues.zh: 今年1月一艘渡轮倾覆，造成至少65人死亡。

cues.en: Why can't the authorities get a handle on this issue?
cues.zh: 当局为什么无法控制这一问题？

cues.en: You know that the Philippines is an archipelago of more than 7,600 islands, so inter-island travel is very common.
cues.zh: 菲律宾是由7600多座岛屿组成的群岛国家，岛际交通十分普遍。

cues.en: A lot of people rely on it as a means of transportation, and obviously it's a cheaper option.
cues.zh: 许多人依靠这种交通方式出行，而且它显然更便宜。

cues.en: But if we've seen the track record of the country, it's a bit patchy.
cues.zh: 但从这个国家的历史记录来看，情况并不理想。

cues.en: A lot of it is due to overloading, overcrowding, lax regulations in terms of enforcement.
cues.zh: 很大一部分原因在于超载、过度拥挤，以及监管规定执行不力。

cues.en: But of course, we hear from officials that they've been trying to tighten this.
cues.zh: 当然，官员们表示一直在努力加强监管。

cues.en: They've been doing a lot of screening, and in fact the Coast Guard official just told us today.
cues.zh: 他们一直在进行大量检查；事实上，海岸警卫队官员今天刚告诉我们。

cues.en: The vessel actually passed a safety compliance assessment that they've conducted.
cues.zh: 这艘船确实通过了他们进行的安全合规评估。

cues.en: It should have enough. When they did the checks, it says that they've had enough life vests for the passengers.
cues.zh: 按理说应该足够。检查时的记录显示，船上有足够乘客使用的救生衣。

cues.en: But that has often been the case.
cues.zh: 但过去经常都是这种情况。

cues.en: Overcrowding, overloading was a common reason, and the other enforcement of regulations.
cues.zh: 过度拥挤、超载是常见原因，另一个原因是法规执行问题。

cues.en: Officials are saying that they've been trying to address that.
cues.zh: 官员们表示，他们一直在努力解决这些问题。

cues.en: So that's why, if you look at the history of the Philippines and marine record, you see this.
cues.zh: 因此，如果你看看菲律宾的历史和海上事故记录，就会看到这种情况。

cues.en: These tragedies occurring, which is of course very unfortunate.
cues.zh: 悲剧不断发生，这当然非常令人遗憾。

cues.en: Karen Lema, speaking to us from Manila.
cues.zh: Karen Lema 从马尼拉为我们报道。

cues.en: Now to a major military development in Yemen.
cues.zh: 现在来看也门的一项重大军事进展。

cues.en: The government there has been battling the Houthi rebel group for more than ten years, and today a strategic port hub has fallen to the rebels.
cues.zh: 也门政府与胡塞叛军已交战十多年。今天，一个战略港口枢纽落入叛军手中。

cues.en: Houthi fighters have seized the city of Mocha on the coast of a key shipping route linking the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean.
cues.zh: 胡塞武装夺取了穆哈市。该市位于连接红海与印度洋的重要航道沿岸。

cues.en: That change comes after days of increased escalation and fighting between the government, backed by Saudi Arabia, and the Houthis, who are backed by Iran.
cues.zh: 这一变化发生在战事升级数日之后。也门政府获沙特支持，胡塞武装则获伊朗支持。

cues.en: Our global affairs reporter is Richard Kagoe.
cues.zh: 我们的全球事务记者是理查德·卡戈。

cues.en: So what we have, the latest from Yemen, is that the port city of Mocha has been overrun by the Houthi fighters.
cues.zh: 也门的最新情况是，港口城市穆哈已被胡塞武装占领。

cues.en: The city fell to the Houthi fighters on Thursday morning.
cues.zh: 这座城市于周四上午落入胡塞武装手中。

cues.en: Government forces have reportedly withdrawn from the city.
cues.zh: 据报道，政府军已撤出这座城市。

cues.en: Together with their allied fighters, they are heading south to a town called Dhubab.
cues.zh: 他们与盟军一起向南撤往一座名为杜巴卜的城镇。

cues.en: So this is a very strategic town on the Red Sea coast in Yemen.
cues.zh: 这是一座位于也门红海沿岸、极具战略意义的城镇。

cues.en: Tell us more about the importance of this port and why there has been so much fighting over its status.
cues.zh: 请详细介绍这个港口的重要性，以及围绕其归属爆发激烈战斗的原因。

cues.en: There has been fighting, actually, and this was reignited last week, on Thursday, between government forces and the Houthi fighters.
cues.zh: 事实上一直在交战，而且上周四政府军与胡塞武装之间的战斗再次爆发。

cues.en: What has happened is that the militants have been targeting to gain more control of strategic towns along the Red Sea coast.
cues.zh: 发生的情况是，武装分子一直试图控制红海沿岸更多战略城镇。

cues.en: So their endgame, basically, is to gain control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
cues.zh: 所以，他们的最终目标基本上是控制曼德海峡。

cues.en: It is on the Red Sea coast, and it is a very key passage that links the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean.
cues.zh: 它位于红海沿岸，是连接红海与印度洋的关键通道。

cues.en: It is an important shipping lane where ships transiting from the Gulf with goods, and also heading to Europe, normally pass through.
cues.zh: 这是一条重要航道，来自海湾、载着货物前往欧洲的船只通常会经过这里。

cues.en: Ships also heading to Asia normally pass through.
cues.zh: 前往亚洲的船只通常也会经过这里。

cues.en: This has been a spillover of the conflict that we have been seeing in the other strait.
cues.zh: 这是我们在另一条海峡看到的冲突外溢。

cues.en: That is the Strait of Hormuz, where we have been seeing fighting between US forces and Iran.
cues.zh: 那就是霍尔木兹海峡，那里一直有美军与伊朗之间的战斗。

cues.en: So this has been a strategy for them to push and to gain control over this strategic pathway.
cues.zh: 因此，这是他们推进并控制这一战略通道的一项策略。

cues.en: It is because they have also intensified attacks across the border in Saudi Arabia, within these southwestern regions.
cues.zh: 这也因为他们加强了对沙特阿拉伯西南部地区的越境袭击。

cues.en: Richard, as you have been reflecting, this conflict has global implications, doesn't it? What has it been doing to the price of oil?
cues.zh: 理查德，正如你所说，这场冲突影响全球，对油价造成了什么影响？

cues.en: Absolutely. The price of oil has risen sharply in the past couple of days and is now slightly over $100 per barrel.
cues.zh: 确实如此。过去几天油价大幅上涨，目前略高于每桶100美元。

cues.en: What this really means is that we are going to see global inflation, also the delivery of this critical supply.
cues.zh: 这意味着全球通胀将会出现，关键供应的运输也会受到影响。

cues.en: Because of the fighting in the Strait of Hormuz, what has happened is that...
cues.zh: 由于霍尔木兹海峡的战斗，情况是……

cues.en: The Saudi Arabian authorities have been shipping out the precious commodity now through the Red Sea.
cues.zh: 沙特当局现在一直通过红海运出这种珍贵商品。

cues.en: But with these sorts of disruptions, you are likely to see a rise in global inflation.
cues.zh: 但有了这些干扰，全球通胀可能会上升。

cues.en: We are expecting to hear from the European Union Central Bank if they are going to be announcing a new interest rate.
cues.zh: 我们正等待欧洲联盟中央银行宣布是否调整利率。

cues.en: So everybody at the moment is watching, and I was really hoping for a bit of relief.
cues.zh: 所以现在所有人都在关注，我原本真的希望能得到一点缓解。

cues.en: But now, with the surge in fighting in the entire region, it is really going to cause massive disruptions.
cues.zh: 但如今整个地区战事升级，势必造成大规模 disruption。

cues.en: It is going to cause massive disruptions in terms of logistics and also the supply of oil.
cues.zh: 这将严重扰乱物流，也会影响石油供应。

cues.en: Richard Kagoe in Nairobi.
cues.zh: 理查德·卡戈从内罗毕报道。

cues.en: To the US now. President Trump has promised $5,000 to every adult American citizen if the Republicans win the midterm elections.
cues.zh: 现在转向美国。特朗普承诺，如果共和党赢得中期选举，每位成年美国公民都能得到5000美元。

cues.en: It is unclear where the money, totaling around $1.3 trillion, would come from, or if President Trump is breaking the law by offering it.
cues.zh: 目前不清楚这笔总额约1.3万亿美元的钱从何而来，也不清楚特朗普总统这样提供是否违法。

cues.en: He made the announcement at a Republican Party convention in Texas, which the Democratic Party has described as a flashy distraction from real issues.
cues.zh: 他在得州共和党大会上宣布了这一消息。民主党称这是转移现实问题的华丽噱头。

cues.en: Our North America editor Sarah Smith was at the convention.
cues.zh: 我们的北美编辑莎拉·史密斯在大会现场。

cues.en: Donald Trump has just finished his big speech to supporters at this Republican convention, and he told them the midterm elections coming up in November.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普刚在共和党大会上向支持者发表演讲，并告诉他们中期选举将在11月举行。

cues.en: They are going to be one of the most important elections in American history.
cues.zh: 他说，这将是美国历史上最重要的选举之一。

cues.en: Then, to try to guarantee a Republican victory in those elections, he made a rather surprising promise.
cues.zh: 随后，为了确保共和党赢得选举，他作出了一项相当令人意外的承诺。

cues.en: He said he would pay $5,000 to every adult in America if, and only if, the Republicans win those midterm elections.
cues.zh: 他说，只有共和党赢得中期选举，他才会向每位美国成年人支付5000美元。

cues.en: So if the Republicans win, you win with us and you get $5,000.
cues.zh: 所以，如果共和党获胜，你就和我们一起赢，还能得到5000美元。

cues.en: It will be called the Trump dividend. We will call it the Trump dividend.
cues.zh: 这将被称为“特朗普红利”。我们就叫它“特朗普红利”。

cues.en: But the only condition on the payment of this dividend that we are going to be making is $5,000 to every adult.
cues.zh: 但我们发放这项红利的唯一条件是：每位成年人获得5000美元。

cues.en: The only caveat I have is that the dividend that we are making must be spent in the United States of America.
cues.zh: 我唯一的限制是，这笔红利必须在美国境内消费。

cues.en: It is not clear that it is legal to make a promise like that, because it is against the law to offer a payment to anybody to influence how they are going to vote.
cues.zh: 不清楚作出这种承诺是否合法，因为以金钱影响他人投票方式是违法的。

cues.en: Donald Trump may say that this is an election promise rather than an election bribe.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普或许会说这是竞选承诺，而不是竞选贿赂。

cues.en: But he did not give any details at all as to how he would pay for this.
cues.zh: 但他完全没有说明将如何支付这笔钱。

cues.en: It could cost a trillion dollars to pay a $5,000 dividend to every American.
cues.zh: 向每位美国人支付5000美元红利，可能要花费一万亿美元。

cues.en: No details of where that money would come from.
cues.zh: 没有说明这笔钱从何而来。

cues.en: But Donald Trump clearly knows that the cost of living is weighing heavily on people's minds, and the war in Iran is helping drive prices up.
cues.zh: 但特朗普显然知道，生活成本沉重压在民众心头，而伊朗战争正助推物价上涨。

cues.en: So he said that he thinks the war in Iran will not be over before the midterm elections.
cues.zh: 所以他说，他认为伊朗战争不会在中期选举前结束。

cues.en: But very shortly after that, he promised prices would plummet as soon as that conflict is wrapped up.
cues.zh: 但他承诺，选举后不久，冲突一结束，物价就会暴跌。

cues.en: And then, in a sign that he clearly thinks he is still a big vote winner for the Republican Party...
cues.zh: 随后，他显然仍认为自己是共和党的重要得票利器……

cues.en: He asks voters to pretend that he is running for election.
cues.zh: 他要求选民假装自己正在参选。

cues.en: Pretend that his name is on the ballot, and come out and vote accordingly in November. Next to
cues.zh: 假装他的名字在选票上，并在11月出来投票。接下来是……

cues.en: The news that two of the four astronauts who served on the Artemis II space mission are retiring from spaceflight.
cues.zh: 最新消息是，曾执行阿耳忒弥斯二号太空任务的四名宇航员中，有两人将退出航天飞行。

cues.en: Back in April, the crew broke a major record in human spaceflight, traveling further away from Earth than ever before.
cues.zh: 今年四月，这支乘组创造了载人航天的新纪录，飞到了人类迄今距地球最远的位置。

cues.en: Reid, Victor, Christina, and Jeremy.
cues.zh: 里德、维克多、克里斯蒂娜和杰里米。

cues.en: We are going for our families. We are going for our teammates. We are going for all humanity.
cues.zh: 我们是为了家人、队友和全人类而去。

cues.en: Engines lit. Four, three, two, one.
cues.zh: 发动机启动。四、三、二、一。

cues.en: Booster ignition and lift-off.
cues.zh: 助推器点火，升空。

cues.en: The crew of Artemis II, now bound for the Moon.
cues.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号乘组如今正飞向月球。

cues.en: The Artemis project eventually aims to reach Mars, but now only one of the four astronauts originally on board will continue with spaceflight.
cues.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯计划最终目标是抵达火星，但如今四名原先在乘组中的宇航员只有一人会继续从事航天飞行。

cues.en: So why would the others stop now after the mission around the Moon was such a success?
cues.zh: 既然绕月任务如此成功，其他人为什么现在要停止飞行？

cues.en: I asked our reporter Alfie Habershon. You could be eventually going to Mars, so why quit now?
cues.zh: 我向本台记者阿尔菲·哈伯森询问：你们最终可能要去火星，那为什么现在退出？

cues.en: We're going to deal with that in a second, but first let's look at who's quit. One is the pilot, Victor Glover.
cues.zh: 这个问题稍后回答，但我们先看看是谁退出了。其中一位是飞行员维克多·格洛弗。

cues.en: He's going to be taking on a teaching job at a university in California now.
cues.zh: 他现在将到加州一所大学担任教学工作。

cues.en: And the other one, the commander, Reid Wiseman, he's going to be continuing on more at base camp.
cues.zh: 另一位是指挥官里德·怀斯曼，他将继续在基地营负责更多工作。

cues.en: He'll help with operations and planning, but he won't fly himself.
cues.zh: 他会协助运行和规划，但不再亲自飞行。

cues.en: As you said, another is the Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen,
cues.zh: 正如你所说，另一位是加拿大宇航员杰里米·汉森，

cues.en: he was also part of this fantastic four, let's call them, he retired earlier this year as well.
cues.zh: 也是这支“梦之四人组”的成员；他今年早些时候也退役了。

cues.en: So we've only got one left, Christina Koch.
cues.zh: 所以现在只剩一人：克里斯蒂娜·科赫。

cues.en: She's the only woman to travel around the Moon.
cues.zh: 她是唯一一位绕月飞行的女性。

cues.en: In terms of why, why is there only one left now who's still willing to fly? Well, it's actually not unusual after
cues.zh: 至于原因，为什么现在只有一人还愿意飞行？其实，在这种任务之后，宇航员停止飞行并不罕见，

cues.en: sort of a major space mission like this for astronauts to stop.
cues.zh: 这类重大的太空任务结束后，宇航员退出是很常见的。

cues.en: And part of the reason for that is even the training to get to this point can take over a decade
cues.zh: 部分原因在于，仅为走到这一步而接受的训练就可能超过十年，

cues.en: or even longer for something this complicated.
cues.zh: 如此复杂的任务，训练时间甚至可能更长。

cues.en: If you think about the operational equipment, the medical training, understanding the kind of scientific side of space,
cues.zh: 想想运行设备、医疗训练，以及理解太空的科学层面，

cues.en: and then preparing your body as well, when you are up there in space, your bone density can change,
cues.zh: 还要锻炼身体；人在太空时，骨密度会发生变化，

cues.en: your muscles can shrink, you are exposed to radiation, and that's not even to mention the mental side.
cues.zh: 肌肉会萎缩，还会受到辐射影响，更不用说心理层面了。

cues.en: It's hard for me and you to imagine here in London what it is like
cues.zh: 在伦敦的我们很难想象，那会是什么感受，

cues.en: being in darkness with three colleagues for so long, staring at the Earth,
cues.zh: 和三位同事长时间置身黑暗中，凝望地球，

cues.en: looking so small, like a sort of tennis ball or smaller than that.
cues.zh: 看着它小得像网球，甚至比网球还小。

cues.en: Retired commander Reid Wiseman spoke to the media the day after landing.
cues.zh: 退役的指挥官里德·怀斯曼在着陆次日接受了媒体采访。

cues.en: He said: I have absolutely no idea what to say. This is... 24 hours ago, the Earth was that big out the window, and we were doing Mach 39.
cues.zh: 他说：我完全不知道该说什么。就在24小时前，窗外的地球还那么大，而我们正以39马赫飞行。

cues.en: And here we are back at Ellington, at home. Victor, Christina, and Jeremy,
cues.zh: 而现在我们回到了埃灵顿，回到了家。维克多、克里斯蒂娜和杰里米，

cues.en: We are bonded forever,
cues.zh: 我们永远紧密相连，

cues.en: and no one down here is ever going to know what the four of us just went through.
cues.zh: 地面上的人永远不会知道我们四个人刚刚经历了什么。

cues.en: And it was the most special thing that will ever happen in my life.
cues.zh: 那是我一生中最特别的经历。

cues.en: Boggles the mind, doesn't it, Alfie? So, what now?
cues.zh: 真让人难以想象，对吧，阿尔菲？那么，接下来呢？

cues.en: A new crew is set for this project. What are the next steps?
cues.zh: 这个项目已经确定了新的乘组。下一步是什么？

cues.en: When will it set foot on the Moon and eventually Mars? Okay, let me take you through the grand plan.
cues.zh: 他们什么时候会登上月球，最终前往火星？好，我来介绍一下总体计划。

cues.en: So, first of all, we've got a bit of a dress rehearsal that's next year.
cues.zh: 首先，明年会进行一次演练。

cues.en: That's Artemis III. It will stay near the Earth's surface rather than go to the Moon,
cues.zh: 那就是阿耳忒弥斯三号。它不会前往月球，而是会停留在接近地球表面的区域，

cues.en: but really practice some of these operational challenges like docking to lunar landers.
cues.zh: 真正演练对接月球着陆器等运行挑战。

cues.en: Then the big one, 2028—that's when humans are planned to set foot on the Moon for the first time in over 50 years.
cues.zh: 然后是重头戏：2028年，计划让人类登上月球，这是五十多年后的第一次。

cues.en: You know, it's since Apollo 17 in 1972, so it really is a big deal.
cues.zh: 上一次还是1972年的阿波罗17号，所以这确实意义重大。

cues.en: But you don't want to spend billions repeating what's been done.
cues.zh: 但没人想花费数十亿美元重复已经做过的事。

cues.en: It wants to go much, much further than that.
cues.zh: 这个计划希望走得远得多。

cues.en: They want to set up a permanent base on the Moon and really carry out experiments to understand
cues.zh: 他们想在月球建立永久基地，并开展实验来了解

cues.en: what it is like for humanity to live somewhere that's not Earth with Mars on the horizon.
cues.zh: 人类生活在地球之外、以火星为目标的地方会是什么样。

cues.en: So very, very ambitious, a little bit far-fetched, Celia, I would say, but undoubtedly very exciting, undoubtedly pretty whimsical. Alfie Habershon.
cues.zh: 所以这非常宏大，我觉得也有点不切实际，西莉亚；但无疑令人兴奋，也相当异想天开。阿尔菲·哈伯森。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast.
cues.zh: 本期播客稍后内容。

cues.en: I think people are struck by its humanity and by how they recognise their own experiences.
cues.zh: 我想，人们会被其中的人性，以及人们能够认出自身经历的方式所打动。

cues.en: Whether it's cooking a kebab or, you know, struggling with a dog.
cues.zh: 无论是烤肉串，还是——你知道——和一条狗相处得很辛苦。

cues.en: The famous medieval work, the Bayeux Tapestry, goes on public display in the UK to sold-out crowds.
cues.zh: 著名的中世纪作品贝叶挂毯将在英国公开展出，门票已售罄。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Now to a story in the city of Portsmouth here in the UK,
cues.zh: 现在来看英国朴次茅斯的一则消息，

cues.en: where over 30 angry demonstrators gathered outside a hotel after hearing false rumours that a group of migrants had arrived there by bus.
cues.zh: 有30多名愤怒的示威者听信一群移民乘巴士抵达那里的错误传言后，聚集在一家酒店外。

cues.en: It was, in fact, Pakistan's Under-19 cricket team that are on tour in England.
cues.zh: 事实上，那是正在英格兰巡回比赛的巴基斯坦19岁以下板球队。

cues.en: Portsmouth has been shaken by anti-migrant protests since Sunday.
cues.zh: 自周日以来，反移民抗议一直令朴次茅斯受到震动。

cues.en: Hundreds, many wearing face coverings, clashed with police and blocked roads to stop buses carrying migrants leaving the city.
cues.zh: 数百人——其中许多人戴着面罩——与警方冲突并堵塞道路，试图阻止载有移民的巴士离城。

cues.en: Our Pakistan correspondent Kerry Davies told me more about the incident.
cues.zh: 我们的巴基斯坦记者克里·戴维斯向我进一步介绍了这起事件。

cues.en: This information that I have received came through Pakistan Cricket Board's chief operating officer, whom I spoke to this morning.
cues.zh: 我收到的信息来自巴基斯坦板球委员会首席运营官，我今天早上与他交谈过。

cues.en: He got this from the Under-19s team manager. According to him, outsiders came on Tuesday night
cues.zh: 他说，这来自19岁以下球队领队。据他所说，周二晚上有外来人员

cues.en: who had come to the floor where the team were staying and then began to knock on the team's doors.
cues.zh: 来到球队下榻的楼层，随后开始敲球队成员的房门。

cues.en: Now he said that the cricket team had responded responsibly and they hadn't escalated the situation.
cues.zh: 他说，板球队作出了负责任的回应，没有让局势升级。

cues.en: Now, the BBC has also been speaking to a local politician, a Reform politician on the county council.
cues.zh: BBC还采访了一名当地政治人物——郡议会的一名改革党议员。

cues.en: He went there to help defuse the situation.
cues.zh: 他前往那里帮助缓和局势。

cues.en: He described what was about 30 or 40 people outside the hotel by the time he got there,
cues.zh: 他说，等他到达时，酒店外大约有30到40人，

cues.en: about an hour, an hour and a half or so after they'd first arrived.
cues.zh: 那是在他们最初到达约一小时、一小时半之后。

cues.en: He said it developed after someone saw, photographed and posted online the cricket team arriving at this hotel in their coach.
cues.zh: 他说，事件起因是有人看到板球队乘大巴抵达这家酒店，拍照后发到了网上。

cues.en: And they had made the assumption that this was a coachload of migrants that had come to this hotel, and that's what spread online.
cues.zh: 他们以为这是一车来到该酒店的移民，这一说法便在网上传播开来。

cues.en: And led to people coming to the hotel to protest against, as you say, this backdrop of anti-migrant protests
cues.zh: 并导致人们来到酒店抗议；正如你所说，这发生在反移民抗议的背景下，

cues.en: that we've seen, particularly in Portsmouth this past week. So, according to both sides, that's what happened.
cues.zh: 尤其是过去一周在朴次茅斯所见的抗议。根据双方说法，事情就是这样发生的。

cues.en: The local politician also said that he'd spoken to the hotel, and the hotel had told him at the time that no one had gone inside the hotel.
cues.zh: 这名地方政治人物还说，他与酒店谈过，当时酒店告诉他没有人进入酒店。

cues.en: So slightly different messages coming through, but ultimately we know that this protest did happen.
cues.zh: 所以传来的信息略有不同，但我们最终知道这场抗议确实发生了。

cues.en: Now, according to the Pakistan Cricket Board, they say that it's the responsibility of the board
cues.zh: 据巴基斯坦板球委员会说，确保安全是邀请巴基斯坦前来的委员会的责任，

cues.en: that are inviting Pakistan over to make sure that the security and safety is paramount.
cues.zh: 他们必须确保安保和安全是最重要的。

cues.en: They've been speaking to the England Cricket Board and say they think
cues.zh: 他们一直在与英格兰板球委员会沟通，并认为

cues.en: it's being treated responsibly, and they hope something like this doesn't happen again.
cues.zh: 此事得到了负责任的处理，也希望类似事件不再发生。

cues.en: Meanwhile, this two-and-a-half-week-or-so tour that the Under-19s have been on of England has been continuing.
cues.zh: 与此同时，19岁以下球队在英格兰进行的约两个半星期的巡回赛仍在继续。

cues.en: They played a match the following day after this incident happened, and they're still in the UK for the next few days as well.
cues.zh: 事件发生后的第二天，他们照常参加了一场比赛，接下来几天也仍会留在英国。

cues.en: Do we know more about how the false information spread that these people were migrants when they were actually young cricket players?
cues.zh: 我们是否知道更多关于这个错误信息如何传播的情况？这些人其实是年轻的板球运动员，却被说成了移民。

cues.en: I think the only information we've had from this local politician is that this photograph was taken as they came off a coach.
cues.zh: 我想，这名地方政治人物给出的唯一解释是：这张照片拍的是他们从大巴上下来的情景。

cues.en: Now, according to him, he says that the coach that was used was the same company that had also been transporting migrants from when they'd come ashore
cues.zh: 据他所说，使用的大巴来自同一家公司；移民上岸后，这家公司也曾运送他们

cues.en: to other facilities, and so that's where some of this confusion had come in and where all of these rumours had begun to spread.
cues.zh: 前往其他设施。因此，部分混淆由此产生，所有这些传言也开始传播。

cues.en: But this also shows how quickly things posted online can get out of hand. People are on high alert, he said,
cues.zh: 但这也说明，网上发布的事情可能迅速失控。他说，人们处于高度警觉之中，

cues.en: and there's such a sort of strong sense of tension, I think, in the city of Portsmouth about a lot of these incidents at the moment.
cues.zh: 而且我认为，朴次茅斯市目前对许多这类事件存在一种强烈的紧张感。

cues.en: That's how quickly and feverishly something like this can happen and build.
cues.zh: 类似的事情就是这样迅速而激烈地发生并不断升级的。

cues.en: Kerry, you're speaking to us from Islamabad. Has there been any reaction to this story so far in Pakistan? I haven't seen any major reaction yet.
cues.zh: 克里，你正在伊斯兰堡接受我们的采访。到目前为止，巴基斯坦对此事有何反应？我还没有看到重大反应。

cues.en: I did notice that the story had been picked up by Dawn, which is the English-language newspaper here in Pakistan, one of the largest ones.
cues.zh: 我注意到，《黎明报》已经报道了此事；这是巴基斯坦最大的英文报纸之一。

cues.en: There will surely be more social-media discussion.
cues.zh: 社交媒体上肯定会有更多讨论。

cues.en: People will send it on WhatsApp, because Pakistan has strong ties with the UK and a large Pakistani diaspora lives there.
cues.zh: 人们会通过WhatsApp转发，因为巴基斯坦与英国联系紧密，那里有庞大的巴基斯坦侨民群体。

cues.en: So I'm sure many people will be looking at this and thinking: how did something that was intended to be, presumably, about sharing
cues.zh: 所以我相信，很多人都会关注此事并思考：一件原本大概是为了促进

cues.en: sport between the two countries has descended into something like this? Kerry Davies in Islamabad.
cues.zh: 两国体育交流的事情，怎么会演变成这样？克里·戴维斯在伊斯兰堡报道。

cues.en: We've reported a lot on the damage left behind by the alarming number of severe wildfires breaking out in Europe this summer.
cues.zh: 我们大量报道了今年夏季欧洲频发的严重野火所造成的破坏。

cues.en: Climate change and the effect of El Niño, the periodic natural warming of the Pacific Ocean, are thought to be behind the unusually high temperatures.
cues.zh: 气候变化和厄尔尼诺——太平洋周期性自然变暖现象——被认为是异常高温的原因。

cues.en: Now the European Union's climate service says August this year was the joint hottest month ever recorded.
cues.zh: 欧盟气候监测机构称，今年8月并列成为有记录以来最热的月份。

cues.en: For more on this, I spoke to our environment correspondent Matt McGrath.
cues.zh: 关于这一点，我采访了环境事务记者马特·麦格拉思。

cues.en: Anyone who's been in the UK, Europe, parts of America, Asia or Africa in recent months will have recognised the intense heat that
cues.zh: 过去几个月，英国、欧洲、美国、亚洲和非洲部分地区的人都感受到了强烈高温。

cues.en: many parts of the world have been suffering from, and the related extreme events such as storms, droughts that have accompanied all those.
cues.zh: 世界许多地区一直在遭受这种高温，以及伴随而来的风暴、干旱等极端事件。

cues.en: So it's no real surprise that the data for August shows that the global temperature for the whole of the world was the warmest on record.
cues.zh: 因此，8月数据表明全球平均气温创下有记录以来最高，并不令人真正意外。

cues.en: I think what is surprising for scientists in some respects is the margin of the scale of the warming.
cues.zh: 我认为，在某些方面令科学家惊讶的是升温的幅度。

cues.en: The Copernicus unit is saying that basically it's 1.65 degrees higher than pre-industrial times,
cues.zh: 哥白尼气候变化服务称，这一数字基本上比前工业化时期高出1.65摄氏度。

cues.en: and that number is really important because politicians in Paris in 2015
cues.zh: 这个数字非常重要，因为2015年在巴黎，

cues.en: agreed that they would try and keep the global temperature under that 1.5-degree level.
cues.zh: 各国政治领导人同意努力把全球气温控制在1.5摄氏度以内。

cues.en: And now we see in this particular month it's gone past that.
cues.zh: 而现在我们看到，仅这个月就超过了这一水平。

cues.en: Now it's not a breach; usually that temperature is measured over ten or maybe 20 years,
cues.zh: 但这还不算突破，因为通常要按十年或可能二十年的时间衡量这一温度。

cues.en: but it's significant because of the direction of travel and the scale of it. And I think that's what's worrying scientists.
cues.zh: 但它意义重大，因为升温趋势和幅度都令人担忧。我认为这正是科学家担心的地方。

cues.en: Matt, we've been hearing this kind of news a lot—the hottest day on record, the hottest month on record.
cues.zh: 马特，我们经常听到这类消息：有记录以来最热的一天、最热的一个月。

cues.en: Can you put this into context for us? How worried should we be?
cues.zh: 你能为我们解释一下背景吗？我们应该有多担心？

cues.en: Several things are different about this particular data.
cues.zh: 我认为，这组数据有几个不同寻常之处。

cues.en: I think the scale of the intense events that we've seen, what used to be normal,
cues.zh: 我认为，我们看到的极端事件规模，与过去的常态相比，

cues.en: I guess back in ten, 15 years ago, you might have one heatwave in the summer or two.
cues.zh: 大约十到十五年前，一个夏天可能只有一两次热浪。

cues.en: Across Europe and the UK, we've had four, potentially five big heatwaves, and elsewhere too.
cues.zh: 你看，欧洲和英国经历了四次、甚至五次大热浪，世界其他地区也是如此。

cues.en: It's the intensity and severity, with events continuing one after another.
cues.zh: 问题在于强度、严重程度，以及这些事件接连不断地发生。

cues.en: And I guess behind all this is what the scientists say is the onward rise of carbon emissions that are doing the most damage here.
cues.zh: 科学家认为，这一切背后是碳排放持续上升，而碳排放造成了最大的损害。

cues.en: They are the key factor in driving up this heat and keeping that heat high.
cues.zh: 碳排放是推高并维持高温的关键因素。

cues.en: We're seeing this around the world this summer, perhaps like never before.
cues.zh: 今年夏天，这种情况在全球各地显现，或许前所未有。

cues.en: I mentioned Europe's wildfires this summer. Are European governments waking up to the dangers of climate change?
cues.zh: 我提到今年夏天席卷欧洲的野火。你认为，欧洲各国政府尤其是现在，开始意识到气候变化带来的危险了吗？

cues.en: It's interesting. Governments are responding.
cues.zh: 有意思。各国政府正在应对。

cues.en: Governments everywhere are very concerned by the scale of heatwaves overwhelming parts of Europe.
cues.zh: 各国政府看到席卷欧洲部分地区的热浪规模后，都非常担忧。

cues.en: You know, nuclear power stations in France that couldn't run because the level of the water in the rivers was too low or too hot.
cues.zh: 比如法国的核电站，就曾因河流水位过低或水温过高而无法运行。

cues.en: We've seen so many aspects of this, governments reacting to the events,
cues.zh: 我们看到了许多方面：政府在应对这些事件，

cues.en: but the bigger question of whether they're taking action on the driving force of this, the emissions of carbon dioxide, that is still in play.
cues.zh: 但更大的问题是，他们是否在应对背后的驱动力，也就是二氧化碳排放；这一问题仍悬而未决。

cues.en: And governments are less, shall we say, committed than they were.
cues.zh: 可以说，各国政府的承诺不如从前。

cues.en: They're more distracted by other things, the cost of living crisis, wars in various places.
cues.zh: 它们更多地被其他问题分散了注意力，比如生活成本危机和各地战争。

cues.en: In the next few months, when leaders meet, we'll see how stuck they are on this issue.
cues.zh: 我想，未来几个月政治领导人会聚在一起，到时我们就会看到他们在这个问题上究竟有多僵持。

cues.en: And Matt, I mentioned the El Niño weather phenomenon; it's also playing a role, but the biggest impact of it is still to come. Yes, that's right.
cues.zh: 马特，我提到过厄尔尼诺天气现象；它也在发挥作用，但其最大影响还未到来。是的，确实如此。

cues.en: I mean, the scientists were saying that we're seeing a rising, a rapidly rising El Niño,
cues.zh: 我的意思是，科学家说厄尔尼诺正在增强，而且增强得很快，

cues.en: It could be one of the strongest El Niños ever felt, possibly the strongest.
cues.zh: 它可能是全球有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺之一，甚至可能是最强的一次。

cues.en: We aren't yet seeing its full impact on temperatures.
cues.zh: 但我们还没有真正看到它对气温的全部影响。

cues.en: That's likely to be at the peak when it's November, December later this year and into next year
cues.zh: 这种影响可能在今年晚些时候的11月、12月以及明年达到峰值，

cues.en: that we'll see that heat coming up out of the oceans, mostly in the Pacific, and impacting the atmosphere.
cues.zh: 届时我们会看到海洋中的热量，主要是太平洋的热量，上升并影响大气。

cues.en: But we're already seeing it in monsoons in various parts of the world.
cues.zh: 但我们已经在世界各地的季风中看到它的影响。

cues.en: We're already seeing its fingerprints.
cues.zh: 我们已经从这些现象中看到它留下的痕迹。

cues.en: So I think much more is to come from it.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，厄尔尼诺的规模还会带来更多影响。

cues.en: El Niño will affect temperatures over the next few months.
cues.zh: 未来几个月，厄尔尼诺及其对气温的影响还会持续显现。

cues.en: Matt McGrath. And lastly, the Bayeux Tapestry, which tells the story of
cues.zh: 马特·麦格拉思。最后，贝叶挂毯讲述了

cues.en: the Norman Conquest of Britain in 1066, and it has just gone on public display in London.
cues.zh: 1066年诺曼征服英格兰的历史，刚刚在伦敦公开展出。

cues.en: It's the first time it's left France since the 11th century.
cues.zh: 这是它自11世纪以来首次离开法国。

cues.en: The tapestry has been loaned to the British Museum until next July,
cues.zh: 这幅挂毯已借展给大英博物馆，展出至明年7月，

cues.en: John McGuire was at the exhibition just before it opened to visitors.
cues.zh: 约翰·麦奎尔在展览向参观者开放前到访现场。

cues.en: He spoke to some of the main people
cues.zh: 他采访了展览的几位主要负责人。

cues.en: At the heart of the show, the Bayeux Tapestry is laid out in a straight line.
cues.zh: 展览的核心是贝叶挂毯，它首次沿直线铺展开来。

cues.en: For the first time. If you've seen it in Normandy on a school trip, it's in a horseshoe.
cues.zh: 这是第一次这样展示。它在诺曼底通常呈马蹄形。

cues.en: But here, it's in a 70-metre-long run.
cues.zh: 但在这里，它沿着一条70米长的直线展开。

cues.en: Along the back, there are representations that correspond with what's going on in the panel with the Norman Conquest.
cues.zh: 背后还有与诺曼征服图案相对应的图像。

cues.en: That tells you exactly what's happening underneath. This is the first chance that members of the public will get.
cues.zh: 它准确说明下方发生了什么。这是公众首次有机会观看。

cues.en: Friends of the museum will get to see the tapestry in all its glory.
cues.zh: 博物馆的朋友们将有机会欣赏完整的挂毯。

cues.en: Two people look remarkably relaxed, considering what you've been through.
cues.zh: 考虑到你们经历的一切，两位看起来异常放松。

cues.en: In the last couple of months and years: Millie Horton-Insch and Nicholas Cullinan, both from the British Museum.
cues.zh: 过去几个月乃至几年里：大英博物馆的米莉·霍顿-英施和尼古拉斯·卡利南。

cues.en: Are you relaxed? I'm excited. I'm mainly very, very excited.
cues.zh: 你们放松吗？我很兴奋，主要是非常非常兴奋。

cues.en: For the first visitors to experience the exhibition and see the tapestry themselves.
cues.zh: 因为首批访客即将亲自体验展览、观看挂毯。

cues.en: I asked you, let's stand somewhere where your favorite part of the tapestry is. You chose Harold's coronation.
cues.zh: 我请你站在最喜欢的部分旁边。你选的是哈罗德加冕礼。

cues.en: Why do you like this bit in particular? It's the moment that the tone of the tapestry completely shifts.
cues.zh: 你为什么特别喜欢这一段？这是挂毯基调完全转变的时刻。

cues.en: King Edward the Confessor has died, and his most powerful earl, Harold.
cues.zh: 忏悔者爱德华国王去世了，他最有权势的伯爵哈罗德……

cues.en: He was crowned, breaking an oath made to Duke William.
cues.zh: 他违背对威廉公爵许下的誓言，加冕为王。

cues.en: And he pretty quickly realizes it's a bad idea when a comet appears in the sky as an ill omen.
cues.zh: 当彗星作为不祥征兆出现在天空时，他很快意识到这不是好主意。

cues.en: Suggesting that bad things lie ahead. Do you see something new every time?
cues.zh: 这暗示前方将有坏事发生。你每次看都会发现新东西吗？

cues.en: You get a chance to have a look at it.
cues.zh: 每次有机会观看时，都会如此吗？

cues.en: Oh, absolutely. Every single time I look at it, I see more details, particularly in the borders or the way the colors shift.
cues.zh: 当然。每次看我都会发现更多细节，尤其是边饰和色彩的变化。

cues.en: I've studied it closely, but its makers studied it even more closely.
cues.zh: 尽管我已仔细看过，它的制作者观察得还要细致得多。

cues.en: Which blows my mind every single time I think about it. Nick, it's been an incredible journey.
cues.zh: 每次想到这一点我都惊叹不已。尼克，这是一段非凡的历程。

cues.en: But today's the day that the people who it's intended for, I suppose, get to see it.
cues.zh: 但今天是它原本面向的人们终于能看到它的日子。

cues.en: Today's the day that we've all been waiting for, which is to welcome visitors to see the tapestry.
cues.zh: 今天是我们一直等待的日子，欢迎访客来观看挂毯。

cues.en: It is here for the first time in almost a thousand years—a historic, momentous day.
cues.zh: 它近千年来首次来到这个国家，今天确实历史性且意义重大。

cues.en: So we're thrilled. Why is it still so significant?
cues.zh: 所以我们非常激动。它为何仍如此重要？

cues.en: It's the change of context: it will be seen here in London.
cues.zh: 只是语境变了：它将在伦敦这里被人们看到。

cues.en: You know, on these shores for the first time in a thousand years.
cues.zh: 也就是千年来首次在这片英国土地上展出。

cues.en: When I first saw it here this summer...
cues.zh: 今年夏天我第一次在这里见到它时，……

cues.en: Being condition checked, having seen it of course in Bayeux, I wasn't quite prepared for how moving it was.
cues.zh: 在进行状况检查时，我当然曾在巴约见过它，却没料到它如此感人。

cues.en: People are excited to be part of this historic, momentous occasion.
cues.zh: 人们都很激动能参与这一历史性、意义重大的时刻。

cues.en: What makes it moving? It's part of our history.
cues.zh: 是什么让它如此感人？它是我们历史的一部分。

cues.en: It's part of a shared history, interestingly with France. We all learn about it, and it's still incredibly relevant.
cues.zh: 它是我们与法国共享的历史，我觉得很有意思。我们都学过它，如今依然极其相关。

cues.en: To think about all of these themes that are woven literally into the tapestry.
cues.zh: 值得思考的是，这些主题都被真实地织进了挂毯。

cues.en: Including scenes of daily life, which I personally find very moving, like the impacts the Norman Conquest had on everyday people.
cues.zh: 包括日常生活场景，我尤其感动于诺曼征服对普通人的影响。

cues.en: Including women and children. What have visitors said?
cues.zh: 包括妇女和儿童。访客们都说了什么？

cues.en: Millie, what have visitors said, and what do you hope they take away from seeing it here?
cues.zh: 米莉，他们都说了什么？你希望访客首次在这里观看后有什么收获？

cues.en: Everyone seems to take away something different. I've never heard the same comment twice.
cues.zh: 奇妙的是，每个人似乎都有不同收获。我从未听过两次相同的评论。

cues.en: Everyone has, as Nick said, been very moved who's seen it.
cues.zh: 正如尼克所说，看过它的人都深受感动。

cues.en: I've been really sort of not surprised.
cues.zh: 我其实并不怎么意外。

cues.en: But pleased by the emotional responses that people have had, and I think people are struck by the humanity of it.
cues.zh: 但人们的情感反应让我欣慰，我想大家都被其中的人性打动。

cues.en: And the way that they can recognize their own experiences, whether it's cooking a kebab or struggling with a dog.
cues.zh: 以及他们能从中认出自己的经历，比如做烤肉，或和狗相处得很艰难。

cues.en: Also I think they've been struck by the brutality and the fact it doesn't shy away from how brutal medieval battle was.
cues.zh: 我还认为，大家也被它的残酷打动；它没有回避中世纪战斗的惨烈。

cues.en: It's not a straightforward piece of Norman propaganda; it's a very complex work of art.
cues.zh: 它不是直白的诺曼宣传品，而是一件非常复杂的艺术作品。

cues.en: The Bayeux Tapestry is on display until next July at the British Museum.
cues.zh: 贝叶挂毯将在大英博物馆展出至明年7月。

cues.en: Although all of the currently available tickets are sold out, more will be released.
cues.zh: 虽然目前所有可售门票已售罄，但还会放出更多票。

cues.en: Something to keep an eye on.
cues.zh: 值得留意。

cues.en: That's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是我们目前的全部内容。如想联系我们，请发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also now watch our episodes in full. Just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 现在也可以观看完整节目，只需在YouTube搜索Global News Podcast。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Chris Cazares, and the editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 本期由克里斯·卡萨雷斯混音，编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿。下期再见。
